supported_environment.browser: Chrome through the host's documented browser Computer Use interface
supported_environment.discovery_requirement: Documented management tabs.query({url}) and tabs.get(id), plus exact-target binding
supported_environment.automatic_application: Skill selection is model-driven; explicit ccuh selection is recommended. Raw host calls are not intercepted.

user_problem_matrix.problem: Work on an inactive tab without selecting it
user_problem_matrix.evidence: Fresh independent Desktop chat reused the same existing Chrome tab, saved once and verified the same target UI; active=false before and after.
user_problem_matrix.scope: Local dummy page through the official Chrome extension; not every browser or site.

user_problem_matrix.problem: Work while the task window is minimized
user_problem_matrix.evidence: Chrome settings saved with minimized metadata before and after in the recorded revision-4 trial.
user_problem_matrix.scope: The intermediate interval was not continuously measured; no universal never-restored guarantee.

user_problem_matrix.problem: Connection failure and original native authentication refusal
user_problem_matrix.evidence: Exact -10000 Sender process is not authenticated was observed in the actual Desktop chat; the product helper repaired the selected override, gracefully restarted the official Desktop, and the same chat read the same native dummy target successfully.
user_problem_matrix.scope: Supported missing/ad-hoc CLI override cases, with backup and preconditions. Generic permission, login, timeout or unsupported-host failures are not automatically repaired.

user_problem_matrix.problem: Observe only the authorized task page
user_problem_matrix.evidence: Exact-URL discovery avoids unrelated inventory; guard checks identity before and after operations and withholds a mismatched result.
user_problem_matrix.scope: Host capture/input is not atomic with navigation. Collection itself is not prevented if navigation races with a host call.

user_problem_matrix.problem: Preserve the user's typing caret and keyboard focus
user_problem_matrix.evidence: Human typing and native dummy-input measurements were recorded while Chrome saves completed, on the same Desktop and on separate ordinary Desktops.
user_problem_matrix.scope: Observed cases only. CCUH cannot intercept an implicit OS focus change inside the host.

user_problem_matrix.problem: Do not force the user's Space back to the task window
user_problem_matrix.evidence: The user confirmed physically typing on another ordinary Desktop without unwanted screen or caret movement while the same guarded browser code saved six times.
user_problem_matrix.scope: No OS Space lock or continuous system-wide Space monitor is supplied.

user_problem_matrix.problem: Recognize the existing browser window instead of creating replacements
user_problem_matrix.evidence: The independent fresh-chat trial rediscovered the original provider tab ID; only the single explicitly authorized setup tab was created. Unit tests cover missing, ambiguous, stale and unresolved lookup cases.
user_problem_matrix.scope: The supported Chrome management interface is required; lookup failure stops instead of creating a replacement.

user_problem_matrix.problem: Recover the running actual Codex engine after a supported repair
user_problem_matrix.evidence: The product requested normal termination, launched the official Desktop once without activation, and native authentication recovered in the same chat. A transient startup-PID monitoring failure was retained in the raw record and the later identity recheck fix was tested separately.
user_problem_matrix.scope: Checkpoint, fresh idle evidence, confirmed background-work status and no unknown native mutation are required. No force quit.

latest_browser_trial.browser_api: official mcp__cua_repl Chrome extension path in a fresh Desktop chat
latest_browser_trial.discovered_issue: Manual helper-source copying caused a parse error before mutation; 0.0.10 adds direct installed-file loading.

new_recovery_behavior.enforced_behavior: The supplied error blocks CLI repair planning, application and the startup drill, including when a stale CLI fixture also exists.

validation.installed_file_import_in_real_node_repl: guard revision 4 and discovery revision 1 loaded without UI operations

privacy_of_release_evidence: This summary contains no user transcript, native page text, user filesystem paths, chat IDs or authentication material. Raw development diagnostics are retained separately.
not_guaranteed: Universal focus, Space, minimized-window or site compatibility.
Atomic prevention of unrelated host data collection or navigation/input races.
Automatic repair of all authentication, permission, connection or timeout failures.
Mandatory interception of every raw Computer Use call.
